notes: London Datastore: MPS Recorded Crime: Geographic Breakdown (OGL v2/v3). Ward-level CSVs (most recent 24 months and historical).
London Datastore API (JSON: resources keyed by id with title, format, url, temporal_coverage_to); the module takes the newest ward-level CSVs (most recent 24 months, and historical).
Optional: a direct URL of a ward-level CSV when the API answer cannot be read (the module downloads it as it is).
ONS Open Geography portal (OGL): generalised ward boundaries. Change the service name when ONS publishes a new vintage (the field names WDyyCD / WDyyNM follow).

Optional: a URL of a CSV/XLSX with ward population (ONS mid-year ward estimates or Census 2021 TS001); otherwise put the file by hand in data/raw/city_london/population/ (columns: a ward code E05... and a total population).
